general.resetDescription: Resets language, forced GPU, multi-instance and automatic updates back to their default values.

about.heading: The Lethalmon project
paragraphs: Lethalmon is a Pokémon fangame inspired by the indie game Lethal Company.
It borrows some of its mechanics while keeping the essence of Pokémon: capturing and battling.
Your goal: explore unknown planets, capture Pokémon and get ready to face Gym Leaders picked at random each run.
Lethalmon offers a new way to rediscover your favorite creatures, with a strong focus on replayability!
This launcher was built to let you keep the game up to date easily and follow its development effortlessly.
